subject: Aboard the colony ship ariadne, in the bay where the work is being done. Hamond has told the bay crews they'll have lettuce by the new year, and they water the hydroponic racks by hand, a can at a time, four hours a shift. Roberta has a spare coolant pump and a drum of proper line, and she wants to mist the whole bay on a timer. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
